objective: Locate bacterial DNA Bacteria are prokaryotic and much smaller than typical plant or animal cells. They have cytoplasm, a cell membrane and a surrounding cell wall. Their genetic material is not enclosed in a nucleus: the main DNA is a single circular loop in the cytoplasm. Bacteria also have ribosomes; no nucleus does not mean no genetic material.

objective: Recognise plant structures Plant and algal cells have a cellulose cell wall that strengthens the cell. A cell wall and other structural evidence can support plant identification even without chloroplasts.
